programme.desc: Sealladh ùr bho Alba. A new view from Scotland.

programme.title: Wallace 's Gromit
programme.desc: Tha latha dheth aig Wallace 's Gromit ach tha cuisean a' dol iomrall orra nuair a chi iad nach eil greim càise air fhàgail aca. Tha fios aca cà 'm faigh iad gu leòr ge-tà - air làrach na gealaich! A' togail rocaid mhòr orainds, tha iad a' dèanamh air na speuran. Air a' ghealaich, tha càise gu leòr ri fhaotainn, ged nach eil am blas buileach a tighinn ri Wallace! Gun fhios dhaibh, tha iad a' dùsgadh eilthireach bho cadal fada 's mar thoradh, 's e faighinn dhachaigh ann aona phìos an dùbhlan as motha a tha gu bhith romhpa... Wallace and Gromit have a day off but all their plans are cast aside when they realise that there's not a bit of cheese in the house. However, they know where they can find plenty - the moon! Building themselves a rocket, they take off to the land of cheese, although Wallace finds that moon-cheese is not entirely to his liking. While there, they inadvertently wake an alien from a long slumber and consequently face the challenge of getting home in one piece.

programme.title: Rudan Beaga Bòidheach/Life’s Little Things
programme.desc: Tha Niamh NicFhionghain a’ coinneachadh daoine òga eile gus rudan beaga fheuchainn a tha a’ toirt toileachas dhaibh. Bho Iòga air mullach cnoc, a bhith a’ sgrìobhadh bàrdachd, gu furachas, dòigh-beatha a’ bhana-campachaidh no a bhith a’ cluich camanachd – tha tòrr ann air an urrainn dhut a bhith taingeil an uair a tha thu air a’ bhlàr a-muigh. Skye digital creator Niamh Mackinnon meets other young people to try out the different little activities that spark joy for them. From hilltop yoga, writing poems, mindfulness, campervan life to playing shinty - there’s so much to appreciate when you just get out there. In Gaelic with English subtitles.

programme.title: Somhairle Spins
programme.desc: Tha Somhairle agus a charaidean bho’n oilthigh a’ deanamh air an t-slighe baidhsagal ainmeil Na Còig Aiseagan, le measgachadh spòrsail de dh’eòlasan, casan sgìth agus tòinean goirt! Somhairle and his university friends take on the infamous Five Ferries cycle route, with an entertaining mix of experience, resulting in tired legs and sore backsides!

programme.title: Somhairle Spins
programme.desc: Tha slighe dùbhlanach aig Somhairle agus a bhràthair Innes air a’ chiad latha aca a’ rothaireachd eadar Inbhir Nis agus Glaschu air an Badger Divide. Somhairle and his brother Innes have a challenging start on their first day cycling between Inverness and Glasgow on the Badger Divide.

programme.title: An Là
programme.desc: Naidheachdan ionadail, nàiseanta is eadar-nàiseanta gach là cuide ri fiosrachadh coimhearsnachd bho BBC ALBA. Local, national and international news and information from BBC ALBA.

programme.title: Geamaichean a' Cho-fhlaitheis Glaschu 2026/Commonwealth Games Glasgow 2026
programme.desc: Spòrs beò agus geàrr-chunntasan an latha bho Glaschu 2026. Air a lìbhrigeadh le Derek ‘Pluto’ Moireach agus sgioba aithris BBC ALBA. Live sporting action and highlights from Glasgow 2026. Presented by Derek ‘Pluto’ Murray and BBC ALBA’s commentary team.

programme.title: Hoolie
programme.desc: An oidhche as motha ann an Alba airson ceòl traidiseanta, tha Hoolie 2025 a’ comharrachadh Sir Billy Connolly, gaisgeach Ghlaschu ann an coimeadaidh is ceòl folk. Le ceòl bho rionnagan ann an saoghal beothail ceòl traidiseanta is folk na h-Alba, a leithid Beluga Lagoon, Trail West, Elephant Sessions is Mànran, cuide ri tachartas ceòlmhor sònraichte don Big Yin gus crìoch a chuir air an oidhche. Scotland’s biggest night of traditional music, Hoolie 2025 celebrates Glasgow comedy and folk music legend Sir Billy Connolly. Featuring performances from a stellar line-up across Scotland’s vibrant folk and traditional music scene including Beluga Lagoon, Trail West, Elephant Sessions and Mànran - followed by the finale of the event, a musical tribute to The Big Yin.

programme.title: A' Cluich 'son a bhith Beo: Von...
programme.desc: ...Cramm v Hitler/Playing to Survive. 2/2. Von Cramm battles Nazi oppression and arrest, seeking dignity and tennis reinstatement. Contains some scenes which some viewers may find upsetting.

programme.title: Samhradh air Sàl
programme.desc: Angus Mackay is joined by his daughter Ruth as they go to sea on a spectacular summer's day. Along the way they encounter a large pod of dolphins who take great delight in racing their small boat. Then it’s time for fishing and chat about the formative role of fishing in Ruth’s upbringing. Anns an dàrna prògram mu dheireadh san t-sreath, tha nighean Aonghais, Rut, còmhla ris agus iad aig muir air latha samhraidh eireachdail. Air an t-slighe, coinnichidh iad ri buidheann leumadairean-mara a tha dannsa mun eathar. Às dèidh sin, tha an t-àm ann airson iasgach agus còmhradh mun bhuaidh a bh’ aig iasgach air beatha Ruth.

programme.title: Belladrum
programme.desc: Tha Fiona NicChoinnich is Niall Iain Dòmhnallach a’ cur fàilt’ air a’ chòmhlan-aon-neach iongantach, RuMac gu Àrd-Ùrlar a’ Ghàrraidh aig Belladrum 2025. Aithnichte airson a dhreach shònraichte folk-punk de dh’òrain aithnichte, choisinn RuMac cliù bho chionn ghoirid air Britain’s Got Talent, agus abair gun robh annas air sluagh Belladrum leis an taisbeanadh accordion gun rian. Fiona MacKenzie and Niall Iain Macdonald welcome the extraordinary one-man band RuMac to the Garden Stage at Belladrum. Known for his unique twisted folk-punk versions of classic hits, RuMac recently gained attention for his performances on Britain’s Got Talent. The crowd are in for a few surprises from the anarchic accordionist.

programme.title: Sight and Sound in Concert
programme.desc: Bob Harris introduces a 1977 concert by Supertramp at Queen Mary College, London. Including the hits Dreamer, Give a Little Bit and Bloody Well Right.

programme.title: TOTP2
programme.desc: Top of the Pops 2 dips into the archives to explore both classic collective hits and smash solo singles spanning 20 early years of Genesis history. From the art-rock Gabriel era of flamboyant theatrics and quirky costumes to their eighties evolution into pop superstars, Genesis are both influential experimentalists and a chart-smashing behemoth. With solo numbers from Peter Gabriel, Phil Collins and Mike + The Mechanics, this is an eclectic two-sided playlist featuring everything from I Can't Dance to I Know What I Like, No Self Control to In the Air Tonight, and Many Too Many to The Living Years. So Turn It On Again and tune in, from prog to pop, Genesis to Revelation, the hits are here on TOTP2.

programme.title: Top of the Pops
programme.desc: Jamie Theakston presents the pop chart programme, first broadcast on 18 February 2000 and featuring Gabrielle, Daphne & Celeste, Hepburn, Joey Negro and Taka Boom, Eiffel 65, Ian Brown, DJ Luck & MC Neat and Oasis.

programme.title: Top of the Pops
programme.desc: Simon Bates presents the pop chart programme, first broadcast on 22 July 1982 and featuring The Belle Stars, Madness, Bananarama, The Brat, Trio, Junior, The Stranglers, Dollar and Irene Cara.

programme.title: Top of the Pops
programme.desc: Gary Davies and Peter Powell present the pop chart programme, first broadcast on 23 July 1986. Featuring Hollywood Beyond, Sinitta, Audrey Hall, Robert Palmer, Haywoode and Madonna.

programme.title: Natural World
programme.desc: Baghani, a Royal Bengal tiger, hunts wild boar in the Ranthambore National Park.

programme.title: Life on Earth
programme.desc: Some 350 million years ago, evolution reached one of its most crucial stages when fish crawled from the water onto the land and became amphibians. Today, newts, salamanders, toads and frogs still survive in great quantities, and there is even one species of frog where the male gives birth from its mouth! Presented by David Attenborough.

programme.title: Voyages of Discovery
programme.desc: Explorer Paul Rose tells the story of three Frenchmen who couldn't stand each other, yet set off on an eight-year scientific mission in one of the most hostile places on the planet. Their plan, to settle an international row by measuring the shape of the planet, took them to the disease-ridden rainforests and oxygen-starved peaks of the Ecuadorian Andes. Rose follows in the footsteps of the 18th-century explorers who were complete innocents abroad and had no idea of the horrors they were letting themselves in for. Despite disease, death and some highly disastrous sexual liaisons, the men made discoveries that fundamentally changed all our lives.

programme.title: The Sentinels
programme.desc: Irène follows a lead into a case involving Mirreau, who appears to be linked to a state secret. Meanwhile at Les Damnés, the Baron discovers that Gisèle has fled. After the tragic death of one of his brothers in arms, Gabriel wants to return to Paris to see his wife and son. In French and German with English subtitles.

programme.title: The Sentinels
programme.desc: The Sentinels must free Mazauric, the brain behind the Dyxenal research, before he divulges critical information about the French serum to the German forces. Meanwhile, the Baron receives a visit at his club from Diane, a German spy who pledges to find Gisèle in exchange for a favour. In French and German with English subtitles.

programme.title: Monster
programme.desc: When schoolboy Minato begins exhibiting strange behaviours, his mother, Sairo, suspects bullying by his teacher and confronts the school. The headmistress seems to be hiding something, and as Sairo pushes for answers, they turn out to be stranger than she imagined. In Japanese with English subtitles.

programme.title: Keeping Up Appearances
programme.desc: Hyacinth realises that Richard is bored after taking early retirement and provides him with a hobby - being artistic with a video camera. However, it's a decision she will live to regret.

programme.desc: Victor and Margaret head off for a weekend at the seaside. Victor is presented with a most unusual and unwelcome gift.

programme.title: Anna Haugh’s Big Irish Food Tour
programme.desc: Boarding the train to the north coast, Anna travels along one of the most spectacular railway journeys on the island to meet Derry Girls actor Ian McElhinney. In the seaside town of Portrush, Ian reminisces about childhood holidays spent enjoying dulse, a local seaweed snack. Inspired, Anna heads to the shoreline at low tide to harvest some for a delicious recipe before moving inland, where the pair try their hand at pig farming, and produce cured meats reminiscent of the Mediterranean.

programme.desc: More famous faces step up to the challenge in a special edition of the music quiz. Competing for their chosen charities are comedy performer La Voix and quiz legend Jenny Ryan, presenter Rav Wilding and singer Chesney Hawkes, plus comedians Fatiha El-Ghorri and Harriet Kemsley. Who will identify the hits fastest and make it to the final? Get ready to shout the answers at the TV!

programme.title: Alan Carr's Picture Slam
programme.desc: Comedian Alan Carr hosts the fun and frantic quiz show where every question is a picture and every picture is worth cash. They could be anything from famous faces, places, products or logos, and teams need to name them all for a Picture Slam. Playing this time are friends Olivia and Danny from Bury St Edmunds, siblings Will and Charmain from Combe Martin, plus mum and daughter Sharon and Lucy from Staffordshire. They battle it out across four rounds, shouting out answers and building their banks. But only one team can make it to the final Super Slam for the chance to win £10,000.

programme.title: Michael McIntyre's Big Show
programme.desc: BAFTA award-winning comedian Michael McIntyre returns with a brand-new episode of his Big Show for an unmissable night of family entertainment at London's prestigious Theatre Royal Drury Lane. Hollywood star Michael Sheen hands over his phone - which is filled with A-list contacts - for an unforgettable edition of 'Send to All'. Olly Murs helps pull off an incredibly ambitious surprise on an unsuspecting superfan, and a truly deserving member of the public becomes the ‘Unexpected Star of the Show’.

programme.title: Pointless Celebrities
programme.desc: Alexander Armstrong and co-host Richard Osman present a special celebrity edition of the general knowledge quiz in which four teams try to come up with the answers that no-one else could think of. The celebrities competing for the Pointless trophy are Larry Dean, Holly Walsh, Desiree Burch, Jessica Fostekew, Morgan Lake, Ashleigh Nelson, Beatie Edney and Michelle Collins.

programme.title: Anna Haugh’s Big Irish Food Tour
programme.desc: Boarding the train to the north coast, Anna travels along one of the most spectacular railway journeys on the island to meet Derry Girls actor Ian McElhinney. Inspired, Anna heads to the shoreline at low tide to harvest some for a delicious recipe before moving inland, where the pair try their hand at pig farming, and produce cured meats reminiscent of the Mediterranean.

programme.title: Alan Carr's Picture Slam
programme.desc: Comedian Alan Carr hosts the fun and frantic quiz show where every question is a picture and every picture is worth cash. They battle it out across four rounds, shouting out answers and building their banks. But only one team can make it to the final Super Slam for the chance to win £10,000.

programme.title: Nigel Slater's Dish of the Day
programme.desc: Nigel doesn't like to waste anything, and in this episode shows us how not to. Here he uses leftover swede in a mouthwatering crumbed lamb and buttered swede mash recipe.

programme.title: The Wonder of Animals
programme.desc: Chris Packham explores the evolution of the great ape's brain to reveal how different parts have been adapted over time by its anatomy, ingenuity and sociability, culminating in one of the most complex brains on the planet. Chris examines how the ability to use two hands asymmetrically sets the great ape apart from other tool-using animals and how social living is linked to the evolution of the amygdala in both humans and our ape cousins. New research reveals how bonobos' peace-loving reputation may have developed through a similar domestication process to that undergone by our pet dogs.

programme.title: Our Lives
programme.desc: After losing his leg in a life changing accident as a teenager, digger operator Llywelyn Williams found solace in the ocean. Surfing played a pivotal role in his recovery, helping him rebuild his life from the ground up and propelling him to the pinnacle of his sport, four consecutive para surfing world championships. Now sitting on top of the adaptive surfing world, Llywelyn faces the ultimate test: staying there. This documentary follows the Welshman from Abersoch as he launches his 2026 season in Australia, the place he travelled to after his accident, rediscovered himself and found a new direction through surfing. But securing a winning start down under won’t be plain sailing. To defend his Australian pro title, Llywelyn must defeat his main rival, a former world champion who has the advantage of competing on his own local beach. Can Llywelyn defy the odds once again, or will the local favourite come out on top?

programme.title: Nigel Slater's Dish of the Day
programme.desc: Nigel doesn't like to waste anything, and in this episode shows us how not to. Here he uses leftover swede in a mouthwatering crumbed lamb and buttered swede mash recipe.

programme.title: The Wonder of Animals
programme.desc: Chris Packham explores the evolution of the great ape's brain to reveal how different parts have been adapted over time by its anatomy, ingenuity and sociability, culminating in one of the most complex brains on the planet. Chris examines how the ability to use two hands asymmetrically sets the great ape apart from other tool-using animals and how social living is linked to the evolution of the amygdala in both humans and our ape cousins. New research reveals how bonobos' peace-loving reputation may have developed through a similar domestication process to that undergone by our pet dogs.

programme.title: Night at the Museum
programme.desc: Looking for a regular job, Larry instead gets the most irregular role of night guard at a New York museum where the exhibits come to life after sunset. Managing the menagerie and figures is tough enough, but then he has to cope with a criminal plot that aims to frame him in a robbery.

programme.title: Our Lives
programme.desc: After losing his leg in a life changing accident as a teenager, digger operator Llywelyn Williams found solace in the ocean. Surfing played a pivotal role in his recovery, helping him rebuild his life from the ground up and propelling him to the pinnacle of his sport, four consecutive para surfing world championships. Now sitting on top of the adaptive surfing world, Llywelyn faces the ultimate test: staying there. This documentary follows the Welshman from Abersoch as he launches his 2026 season in Australia, the place he travelled to after his accident, rediscovered himself and found a new direction through surfing. But securing a winning start down under won’t be plain sailing. To defend his Australian pro title, Llywelyn must defeat his main rival, a former world champion who has the advantage of competing on his own local beach. Can Llywelyn defy the odds once again, or will the local favourite come out on top?

programme.title: Reporting Scotland
programme.desc: All the weekend national, UK-wide and international news on Saturday evening at 7.

programme.title: The Repair Shop on the Road
programme.desc: In this episode, the experts lend their skills to a community project, hear the story behind a new treasure to be repaired and visit a local crafting hero. York Minster is one of our most magnificent cathedrals, boasting the world’s largest expanse of medieval stained glass. But the stonework of this glorious gothic monument is crumbling away on a daily basis. Will and Dom join the new generation of stonemasons being trained to save it, harnessing modern technology while still using centuries-old skills. Will’s Yorkshire odyssey continues in Cawthorne, where Elwin presents him with a huge drum that has been owned by the local marching band since the 1850s. The damaged paintwork, ill-fitting skins and loose cords aren’t befitting such a magnificent instrument, so percussion expert Pete Woods takes on the mammoth task of getting it back into a playable condition. Dom heads further south through God’s Own Country to visit occasional Repair Shop expert Jonathan Reid in his Sheffield workshop. Here the master putter, or scissor-maker, is keeping the endangered craft of making scissors by hand alive, and he’s eager to share some secrets of the trade with his fellow craftsman.

programme.title: Interior Design Masters with Alan Carr
programme.desc: The eight remaining designers pair up to create uplifting spaces for a homelessness charity in London. They tackle an arts and crafts room, a group workshop room, a wellness area and an employment suite. The charity’s ambassador, Dara Ó Briain, joins Alan to check in on the designers before Michelle and guest judge Sophie Robinson critique the spaces.

programme.title: Bill Douglas: My Best Friend
programme.desc: The story of the extraordinary friendship between Scottish film-maker Bill Douglas and his lifelong companion and collaborator Peter Jewell. Bill Douglas was Scotland’s finest director. In his short career, he made four films: autobiographical trilogy My Childhood, My Ain Folk and My Way Home about his appalling childhood, and Comrades, an epic about a momentous moment in English history. Bill is celebrated by other great film-makers such as Lynne Ramsay, Lenny Abrahamson, Satajit Ray and Yuliya Solntseva. Bill's life was transformed when he was on national service in the Egyptian desert and met Peter Jewell, the man who would become his lifelong friend. The two men had very different backgrounds, but they formed a unique bond that channelled a tremendous creative energy. In this film, Peter reminisces about the life he shared with Bill in their tiny Soho flat filled with cinema memorabilia. Their love of the movies leads them to start experimenting with an 8mm camera. Peter’s memories and musings about the legacy Bill left behind are illustrated with these never-before-seen short films.

programme.title: Cumming to the Cabaret
programme.desc: Michelle gets assistance from Club Cumming's queen of crafting, Brini, in creating a headdress, while comedian Jake helps boost her confidence on the mic. Daphne, Michelle and Cunning work together to build a kissing booth.

programme.title: Cumming to the Cabaret
programme.desc: Alan reveals Darren's softer side as Club Cumming unites to raise funds for a neighbourhood dog rescue. Michelle grapples with family issues, while Daphne's major decision is complicated by matters of the heart.

programme.title: Susie McCabe: Femme Fatality
programme.desc: Acclaimed stand-up Susie McCabe brings her sensational show Femme Fatality to a sold-out King’s Theatre in Glasgow. From growing up gay in the 80s and 90s, to working on building sites and becoming a successful stand-up comic, Susie McCabe's life is jam-packed with rich material, and the gifted performer delivers a barnstorming evening of razor-sharp punchlines and observational comedy.

programme.title: Not Going Out
programme.desc: Lee's lifestyle catches up on him and he is forced to wait on a hospital ward for routine surgery on his gallbladder until his blood pressure comes down. But visits from the parents-in-law and Anna and Toby, who arrive to ask him a question he doesn't want to hear, ensure that his stress levels remain dangerously high.

programme.title: Mrs Brown's Boys
programme.desc: When Agnes's family starts making comments about her weight, she decides to go on a diet and quickly discovers just how difficult it is to overcome her craving for fish and chips. Cathy brings her new, older man home. He is a psychiatrist and seems much more interested in Agnes than in Cathy. Meanwhile, Rory has a professional dilemma when he discovers some illegal drugs at work.

programme.title: Mrs Brown's Boys
programme.desc: Spartacus, the old family dog, is looking poorly. Reluctantly, the family decide the time has come to put her in a home. However, when the Brown children gather together to decide how to break the sad news to their mother, Agnes gets the wrong end of the stick. Under the impression that her children are planning on putting her in a nursing home, a furious Agnes sets out to persuade her children she is not going senile.

programme.title: Ghosts Australia
programme.desc: The Australian version of the hit UK series. When city couple Kate and Sean inherit Ramshead Manor, a run-down country estate, they see it as a sign for a fresh new start. Kate must navigate the ghosts' issues while trying to start a hotel business with Sean, who remains unable to see them.

programme.title: Big Lizard
programme.desc: Cosima and Big Lizard find some fascinatingly slippery fruit, but bringing it safely back to the ship is more challenging than they imagined!

programme.title: The Weasy Family
programme.desc: Weasy and the ducklings race around an obstacle course on a sheep and a chicken. When Weasy spots a device in the Farm of the Future that can give one animal the abilities of another, he sees his chance to win.

programme.title: Super Happy Magic Forest
programme.desc: Only wood elves have ever defeated the mighty Eye of Vernon hat, so when the Riddlemaster wears the eye to take over the forest, the heroes quest to Wood Elf Wood to get help. However, Twinkle really doesn’t want to, as wood elves are so stuck up! Struggling to contain her irritation with their high-and-mighty ways, Twinkle still manages to offend them, and the heroes wonder how they will ever save the forest now.

programme.title: Grizzy and the Lemmings
programme.desc: The Lemmings organise a mega-party, leading to the cabin being invaded by bats.

programme.title: Duck and Frog
programme.desc: Duck and Frog must move a famous pop star’s possessions from one mansion to another. However, they are unable to do it with anything remaining in one piece.

programme.title: Pokémon Horizons
programme.desc: Liko, Roy and Dot team up with Zirc and Onia on an unusual mission!

programme.title: Winx Club - The Magic Is Back
programme.desc: The Winx plan a day of adventure in Magixia, but Griselda's restrictions and an incomplete project keep them grounded... until Robin helps them sneak away.

programme.title: The Next Step: Cheer
programme.desc: When a legendary coach abruptly leaves a highly successful cheerleading gym, the team are left in disarray, The Next Step’s Kenzie steps in to take over what’s left of the team, desperate to prove she is more than just a dancer, and that she can build this rag-tag group of athletes into a contender for nationals.

programme.title: Blue Peter
programme.desc: Joel takes on an epic superhero challenge as he attempts something that has never been done before - climbing one of the UK’s tallest buildings Spidey-style!

programme.title: Newsround
programme.desc: Topical news magazine for children.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: It’s the first ever RHS Sandringham Flower Show, and Arit Anderson, Jamie Butterworth and Frances Tophill are on hand to take a look around. From spectacular show gardens to a floral marquee packed full of horticultural goodies, there is something to whet the appetite. A local grower who knows everything there is to know about roses provides expert advice, while a National Collection holder in Lincolnshire shines a light on drought-tolerant achilleas. A couple in Kent share their new-found love of succulents, with some useful advice on how to care for them. And in Hampshire, a plantsman conveys his passion for carrying on the family tradition of running a nursery.

programme.title: This Wild Life
programme.desc: Wildlife expert Saba Douglas-Hamilton, together with her husband Frank and their three young children, move to the romantic Samburu National Reserve in Kenya to run a safari camp for the first time. But life out there isn't easy. There are monkeys in the kitchen, floods threatening the camp and, with no fences to keep out the wildlife, elephants are regular house guests. This series follows their ups and downs as the family struggles to keep guests, elephants, lions and even crocodiles smiling. Wildlife expert Saba Douglas-Hamilton and the elephant rescue team race to save the life of a recently orphaned calf. The baby elephant is flown to an elephant orphanage in Nairobi. But with a terror threat on the Kenya's east coast, the family's safari camp is in crisis. Saba must work to save the business and do all she can to try to protect Samburu's trusting elephants.

programme.title: Funeral in Berlin
programme.desc: Harry Palmer is sent to Berlin with instructions to assist Colonel Stok, the Russian head of security for the Berlin Wall, who is eager to defect to the West. However, Palmer discovers he cannot trust anyone in the city where the double-cross is a unit of currency.

programme.title: The Great British Sewing Bee
programme.desc: It’s week 2, and judges Patrick Grant and Esme Young put the 11 remaining sewers through their paces with three challenges themed around prints and colours. First, the sewers take on the Pattern Challenge, constructing a pattern-matched shell top with adaptive elements, including invisible side-zips and a high-low hem. In the Transformation Challenge, they are given second-hand clothes in purple and brown, the judges’ least-favourite colours, and have to create garments that will convince them to change their minds. Finally, in the Made-to-Measure, the sewers must create an eye-catching outfit in just one colour.

programme.title: High Society
programme.desc: Musical comedy. Time is short if playboy CK Dexter-Haven is to reclaim his former wife before she remarries. Cynical reporter Mike Connor is covering the wedding.

programme.title: Casablanca
programme.desc: Classic romantic drama. Rick's Cafe is a centre for criminals, refugees, resistance fighters and Nazis. Its cynical owner takes risks for no-one - until the arrival of Ilsa.

programme.title: Flog It!
programme.desc: This time, Flog It! comes from the RAF Museum in Cosford, Shropshire. Antiques experts Adam Partridge and Claire Rawle are on hand to find a selection of objects to take to auction. Claire gets sentimental over a music box and Adam discovers a silver cigarette case from Russia. Paul Martin falls for an iconic bike and visits the nearby historic Ironbridge to investigate the start of the industrial revolution.

programme.title: Rugby League: Super League
programme.desc: Coverage from the Super League as Leigh Leopards take on Warrington Wolves.

programme.title: Evolution
programme.desc: How did the ostrich come to lay the biggest egg on earth? Chris Packham explores the way reproduction has shaped life on earth and the surprising evolutionary origins of sex, eggs and birds. It's a four-billion-year journey contained within a shell.

programme.title: Bonnie Tyler at the BBC
programme.desc: A celebration of the incredible 50-year career of Bonnie Tyler, the only Welsh performer to have a US number one. Bonnie's distinctive husky vocals and powerful performances made her one of Britain's best-loved and most enduring artists. This collection from the BBC archive showcases some of her biggest and best moments from over the decades, with hits including Lost in France, Holding Out for a Hero, It's a Heartache and the song frequently voted the greatest power ballad in pop history, Total Eclipse of the Heart.

programme.title: Top of the Pops
programme.desc: Revel in many of the biggest singles of 2002 as the Top of the Pops archives are opened once again. P!nk gets the party started, and there are hits from Shakira, Sugababes and Atomic Kitten. The Red Hot Chili Peppers are back alongside Oasis and Kelly Rowland with her first major release after leaving Destiny’s Child. Also, the TV talent show introduces Will Young with the biggest selling track of the year. Featuring P!nk, The Coral, Shakira, Liberty X, DJ Sammy and Yanou and Do, Oasis, Will Young, Sugababes, Nelly and Kelly Rowland, Atomic Kitten, Red Hot Chili Peppers, Avril Lavigne, Daniel Bedingfield, Badly Drawn Boy, Holly Valance, Elvis vs JXL, Ja Rule and Ashanti, Girls Aloud and Enrique Iglesias.

programme.title: Top of the Pops
programme.desc: A look back at a year where Top of the Pops comes under attack from the TV talent show and girl groups are back at the top. 2002 sees the return of Sugababes 2.0, the chart domination of talent show winners (and losers), as well as the cultural phenomenon which is Vanessa Carlton with that piano riff. Meanwhile, Swedish band The Hives arrive at Television Centre, whilst indie rock continues its early 00s climb of the chart. With 2,000 episodes under its belt, TOTP is more diverse and dominant than ever before. Contributors include Mutya and Keisha from Sugababes, Kimberly Walsh from Girls Aloud, Vanessa Carlton, Liberty X, The Hives, Frankie Bridge from S Club Juniors, Gareth Gates and broadcasters Trevor Nelson, Pete Tong and Sarah Cawood.

programme.title: Top of the Pops
programme.desc: An exclusive set from the Red Hot Chili Peppers, performed in front of Television Centre, comprising old and new songs. From 2006.

programme.title: Girls Aloud at the BBC
programme.desc: They first triumphed on the 2002 reality show Pop Stars: The Rivals, and over the next decade, dominated the UK charts, the tabloids and the affections of fans of pure pop perfection. Here are the group’s greatest musical moments and biggest hits, from their chart-topping debut Sound of the Underground to Something Kind of Ooooh, Can’t Speak French, Call the Shots and beyond.

programme.desc: The Winx plan a day of adventure in Magixia, but Griselda's restrictions and an incomplete project keep them grounded... until Robin helps them sneak away.

programme.title: The Next Step: Cheer
programme.desc: When a legendary coach abruptly leaves a highly successful cheerleading gym, the team are left in disarray, The Next Step’s Kenzie steps in to take over what’s left of the team, desperate to prove she is more than just a dancer, and that she can build this rag-tag group of athletes into a contender for nationals.

programme.title: Blue Peter
programme.desc: Joel takes on an epic superhero challenge as he attempts something that has never been done before - climbing one of the UK’s tallest buildings Spidey-style!

programme.title: Newsround
programme.desc: Topical news magazine for children.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: It’s the first ever RHS Sandringham Flower Show, and Arit Anderson, Jamie Butterworth and Frances Tophill are on hand to take a look around. From spectacular show gardens to a floral marquee packed full of horticultural goodies, there is something to whet the appetite. A local grower who knows everything there is to know about roses provides expert advice, while a National Collection holder in Lincolnshire shines a light on drought-tolerant achilleas. A couple in Kent share their new-found love of succulents, with some useful advice on how to care for them. And in Hampshire, a plantsman conveys his passion for carrying on the family tradition of running a nursery.

programme.title: This Wild Life
programme.desc: Wildlife expert Saba Douglas-Hamilton, together with her husband Frank and their three young children, move to the romantic Samburu National Reserve in Kenya to run a safari camp for the first time. But life out there isn't easy. There are monkeys in the kitchen, floods threatening the camp and, with no fences to keep out the wildlife, elephants are regular house guests. This series follows their ups and downs as the family struggles to keep guests, elephants, lions and even crocodiles smiling. Wildlife expert Saba Douglas-Hamilton and the elephant rescue team race to save the life of a recently orphaned calf. The baby elephant is flown to an elephant orphanage in Nairobi. But with a terror threat on the Kenya's east coast, the family's safari camp is in crisis. Saba must work to save the business and do all she can to try to protect Samburu's trusting elephants.

programme.title: Funeral in Berlin
programme.desc: Harry Palmer is sent to Berlin with instructions to assist Colonel Stok, the Russian head of security for the Berlin Wall, who is eager to defect to the West. However, Palmer discovers he cannot trust anyone in the city where the double-cross is a unit of currency.

programme.title: The Great British Sewing Bee
programme.desc: It’s week 2, and judges Patrick Grant and Esme Young put the 11 remaining sewers through their paces with three challenges themed around prints and colours. First, the sewers take on the Pattern Challenge, constructing a pattern-matched shell top with adaptive elements, including invisible side-zips and a high-low hem. In the Transformation Challenge, they are given second-hand clothes in purple and brown, the judges’ least-favourite colours, and have to create garments that will convince them to change their minds. Finally, in the Made-to-Measure, the sewers must create an eye-catching outfit in just one colour.

programme.title: High Society
programme.desc: Musical comedy. Time is short if playboy CK Dexter-Haven is to reclaim his former wife before she remarries. Cynical reporter Mike Connor is covering the wedding.

programme.title: Casablanca
programme.desc: Classic romantic drama. Rick's Cafe is a centre for criminals, refugees, resistance fighters and Nazis. Its cynical owner takes risks for no-one - until the arrival of Ilsa.

programme.title: Suzie Lee's Great Food Made Simple
programme.desc: Suzie makes a delicious Korean crispy cauliflower dish.

programme.title: Barra's Return of the Wild
programme.desc: Barra visits a group in Ljublajana in Slovenia where conservation starts at the bus stops. We find out the surprising location of the place now being dubbed Europe’s dolphin capital, and see the efforts being made to prevent Spain’s mink from becoming extinct. Back home, Barra dons his beekeeping suit to meet the keepers of the hives at the Northern Ireland Assembly.

programme.title: Rugby League: Super League
programme.desc: Coverage from the Super League as Leigh Leopards take on Warrington Wolves.

programme.title: Evolution
programme.desc: How did the ostrich come to lay the biggest egg on earth? Chris Packham explores the way reproduction has shaped life on earth and the surprising evolutionary origins of sex, eggs and birds. It's a four-billion-year journey contained within a shell.

programme.title: Bonnie Tyler at the BBC
programme.desc: A celebration of the incredible 50-year career of Bonnie Tyler, the only Welsh performer to have a US number one. Bonnie's distinctive husky vocals and powerful performances made her one of Britain's best-loved and most enduring artists. This collection from the BBC archive showcases some of her biggest and best moments from over the decades, with hits including Lost in France, Holding Out for a Hero, It's a Heartache and the song frequently voted the greatest power ballad in pop history, Total Eclipse of the Heart.

programme.title: Top of the Pops
programme.desc: Revel in many of the biggest singles of 2002 as the Top of the Pops archives are opened once again. P!nk gets the party started, and there are hits from Shakira, Sugababes and Atomic Kitten. The Red Hot Chili Peppers are back alongside Oasis and Kelly Rowland with her first major release after leaving Destiny’s Child. Also, the TV talent show introduces Will Young with the biggest selling track of the year. Featuring P!nk, The Coral, Shakira, Liberty X, DJ Sammy and Yanou and Do, Oasis, Will Young, Sugababes, Nelly and Kelly Rowland, Atomic Kitten, Red Hot Chili Peppers, Avril Lavigne, Daniel Bedingfield, Badly Drawn Boy, Holly Valance, Elvis vs JXL, Ja Rule and Ashanti, Girls Aloud and Enrique Iglesias.

programme.title: Top of the Pops
programme.desc: A look back at a year where Top of the Pops comes under attack from the TV talent show and girl groups are back at the top. 2002 sees the return of Sugababes 2.0, the chart domination of talent show winners (and losers), as well as the cultural phenomenon which is Vanessa Carlton with that piano riff. Meanwhile, Swedish band The Hives arrive at Television Centre, whilst indie rock continues its early 00s climb of the chart. With 2,000 episodes under its belt, TOTP is more diverse and dominant than ever before. Contributors include Mutya and Keisha from Sugababes, Kimberly Walsh from Girls Aloud, Vanessa Carlton, Liberty X, The Hives, Frankie Bridge from S Club Juniors, Gareth Gates and broadcasters Trevor Nelson, Pete Tong and Sarah Cawood.

programme.title: Top of the Pops
programme.desc: An exclusive set from the Red Hot Chili Peppers, performed in front of Television Centre, comprising old and new songs. From 2006.

Featuring P!nk, The Coral, Shakira, Liberty X, DJ Sammy and Yanou and Do, Oasis, Will Young, Sugababes, Nelly and Kelly Rowland, Atomic Kitten, Red Hot Chili Peppers, Avril Lavigne, Daniel Bedingfield, Badly Drawn Boy, Holly Valance, Elvis vs JXL, Ja Rule and Ashanti, Girls Aloud and Enrique Iglesias.

programme.title: Top of the Pops
programme.desc: A look back at a year where Top of the Pops comes under attack from the TV talent show and girl groups are back at the top. 2002 sees the return of Sugababes 2.0, the chart domination of talent show winners (and losers), as well as the cultural phenomenon which is Vanessa Carlton with that piano riff. Meanwhile, Swedish band The Hives arrive at Television Centre, whilst indie rock continues its early 00s climb of the chart. With 2,000 episodes under its belt, TOTP is more diverse and dominant than ever before. Contributors include Mutya and Keisha from Sugababes, Kimberly Walsh from Girls Aloud, Vanessa Carlton, Liberty X, The Hives, Frankie Bridge from S Club Juniors, Gareth Gates and broadcasters Trevor Nelson, Pete Tong and Sarah Cawood.

In the end, neither of them manage to find any pieces of meteorite, prompting Glitch to send the Grimbots to drag a huge space rock to Earth to help him! programme.title: Nobody's Fool
programme.desc: Emily Atack and Danny Dyer host a strategic reality quiz packed full of drama and deception. With fewer players left and the finale looming, alliances tighten and betrayals feel inevitable. Harry reveals himself to be great at maths and this has not gone unnoticed. The game has now turned - whispered conversations, overheard plots and shifting loyalties dominate the house as players begin thinking not about survival, but about who they want to face in the final. A maths/shooting-led challenge rewards bold, decisive play from Billy and delivers a powerful advantage - but are Harry's days numbered? With trust diminishing by the hour, does Kamaal succumb to group pressure or does he turn on one of the co-conspirators - and also his friend - Ella? Regardless, playing nicely is no longer an option.

programme.title: Long Lost Family
programme.desc: Both stories in this episode celebrate the unique bond between brothers - in our first case, Lee Sharp's adoptive parents had told him that he was a foundling, but the Long Lost Family team discovers that this simply isn't true as the true story leads Lee to a sibling that he never knew he had and with whom he shares so much. In our second case, Peter MacDonald's father snatched him from his mother's arms as a baby as a train carrying her and his older brother Trevor pulled out of Preston station - it was the last time Peter ever saw them, and he longs to see Trevor again after 58 years of missing his big brother.

programme.title: James Martin's American Adventure
programme.desc: James's American adventure continues with a cruise along California's Pacific Coast as he rides his motorcycle through the coastal city of Santa Cruz and takes in the fertile nature of the local farmland along the way - he then shops at a local farmers' market before cooking his own recipes on a family-run artichoke farm. James can't leave Santa Cruz before trying his hand at surfing - only to be upstaged by a dog when he does - and uses the area's rich farming heritage as inspiration to cook California-style food back at home in the UK.

programme.title: Prue Leith's Cotswold Kitchen
programme.desc: This series takes us into the home of Prue Leith and her husband John as she, friends and her husband cook mouth-watering dishes and explore the joys of their Cotswold home and local area. In this episode, Prue cooks a range of recipes perfect for entertaining guests before welcoming Alison Hammond into her kitchen as the pair make something sweet together - in a bid to prove the ingredient's versatility, Prue then cooks two recipes using watermelon in unusual ways. Prue also utilises a pre-made shop-bought ingredient for quick and delicious party food both sweet and savoury, her husband John visits a farm to see how local sheepdogs are trained, and we hear from a group of friends on how they produce smoked salmon using age-old techniques.

programme.title: Nanny Mcphee
programme.desc: Fantasy family comedy. Recently-widowed Cedric Brown struggles to control his brood of seven children, who have managed to drive away 17 different nannies with their bad behaviour - when Cedric arranges for the mysterious Nanny McPhee to come and look after the children, led by the precocious Simon, the children attempt to scare her in the same way as they have the others, but it soon becomes clear that their bad behaviour brings about supernatural and eerie reprisals... Meanwhile, Cedric's uptight Aunt Adelaide has insisted that unless he finds a new wife within a month, she will take one of the children into custody. With their father's utter hopelessness at courtship common knowledge and facing a future in the workhouse - or worse, in the care of relatives, the children turn to their new nanny to save the day.

programme.title: The Staircase
programme.desc: December 2001. When businesswoman and beloved mother Kathleen Peterson is found dead after reportedly falling down a flight of stairs, the unusually bloody scene leads police to focus their attention on her husband, author and aspiring local politician Michael Peterson. But while the Peterson's blended family rallies around their patriarch, the investigation quickly zeroes in on Michael's secret life, calling the couple's seemingly picture-perfect marriage into question.

programme.title: The Staircase
programme.desc: After posting bail, Michael and his high-powered attorney David Rudolf piece together their defence, while considering an offer from Jean-Xavier de Lestrade, a French documentarian eager to profile the case. As teams of forensic experts on both sides recreate the night of Kathleen's death, Michael's children grapple with shocking new information about their father - and his stepdaughter Caitlin wrestles with her own doubts.

programme.title: Sorry, I Didn't Know
programme.desc: Jimmy Akingbola hosts the classic panel show with a twist - this time Charlene White, Shazia Mirza, Jessica Fostekew and Stephen K Amos join team leaders Chizzy Akudolu and Eddie Kadi to take viewers on a tour of Black British history. Insightful, educational, bold, tongue-in-cheek and above all very funny, the teams do battle over four rounds - it's history with a touch of colour.

Meanwhile, Cedric's uptight Aunt Adelaide has insisted that unless he finds a new wife within a month, she will take one of the children into custody. With their father's utter hopelessness at courtship common knowledge and facing a future in the workhouse - or worse, in the care of relatives, the children turn to their new nanny to save the day.

programme.title: The Staircase
programme.desc: After posting bail, Michael and his high-powered attorney David Rudolf piece together their defence, while considering an offer from Jean-Xavier de Lestrade, a French documentarian eager to profile the case. programme.title: Sorry, I Didn't Know

Insightful, educational, bold, tongue-in-cheek and above all very funny, the teams do battle over four rounds - it's history with a touch of colour.

programme.title: Nobody's Fool
programme.desc: Emily Atack and Danny Dyer host a strategic reality quiz packed full of drama and deception. With fewer players left and the finale looming, alliances tighten and betrayals feel inevitable. Harry reveals himself to be great at maths and this has not gone unnoticed. The game has now turned - whispered conversations, overheard plots and shifting loyalties dominate the house as players begin thinking not about survival, but about who they want to face in the final. A maths/shooting-led challenge rewards bold, decisive play from Billy and delivers a powerful advantage - but are Harry's days numbered? With trust diminishing by the hour, does Kamaal succumb to group pressure or does he turn on one of the co-conspirators - and also his friend - Ella? Regardless, playing nicely is no longer an option.

programme.title: Long Lost Family
programme.desc: Both stories in this episode celebrate the unique bond between brothers - in our first case, Lee Sharp's adoptive parents had told him that he was a foundling, but the Long Lost Family team discovers that this simply isn't true as the true story leads Lee to a sibling that he never knew he had and with whom he shares so much. In our second case, Peter MacDonald's father snatched him from his mother's arms as a baby as a train carrying her and his older brother Trevor pulled out of Preston station - it was the last time Peter ever saw them, and he longs to see Trevor again after 58 years of missing his big brother.

In this episode, Prue cooks a range of recipes perfect for entertaining guests before welcoming Alison Hammond into her kitchen as the pair make something sweet together - in a bid to prove the ingredient's versatility, Prue then cooks two recipes using watermelon in unusual ways. Prue also utilises a pre-made shop-bought ingredient for quick and delicious party food both sweet and savoury, her husband John visits a farm to see how local sheepdogs are trained, and we hear from a group of friends on how they produce smoked salmon using age-old techniques.

programme.title: Nanny Mcphee
programme.desc: Fantasy family comedy. Recently-widowed Cedric Brown struggles to control his brood of seven children, who have managed to drive away 17 different nannies with their bad behaviour - when Cedric arranges for the mysterious Nanny McPhee to come and look after the children, led by the precocious Simon, the children attempt to scare her in the same way as they have the others, but it soon becomes clear that their bad behaviour brings about supernatural and eerie reprisals... Meanwhile, Cedric's uptight Aunt Adelaide has insisted that unless he finds a new wife within a month, she will take one of the children into custody. With their father's utter hopelessness at courtship common knowledge and facing a future in the workhouse - or worse, in the care of relatives, the children turn to their new nanny to save the day.

programme.title: The Staircase
programme.desc: December 2001. When businesswoman and beloved mother Kathleen Peterson is found dead after reportedly falling down a flight of stairs, the unusually bloody scene leads police to focus their attention on her husband, author and aspiring local politician Michael Peterson. But while the Peterson's blended family rallies around their patriarch, the investigation quickly zeroes in on Michael's secret life, calling the couple's seemingly picture-perfect marriage into question.

programme.title: The Staircase
programme.desc: After posting bail, Michael and his high-powered attorney David Rudolf piece together their defence, while considering an offer from Jean-Xavier de Lestrade, a French documentarian eager to profile the case. As teams of forensic experts on both sides recreate the night of Kathleen's death, Michael's children grapple with shocking new information about their father - and his stepdaughter Caitlin wrestles with her own doubts.

programme.title: Sorry, I Didn't Know
programme.desc: Jimmy Akingbola hosts the classic panel show with a twist - this time Charlene White, Shazia Mirza, Jessica Fostekew and Stephen K Amos join team leaders Chizzy Akudolu and Eddie Kadi to take viewers on a tour of Black British history. Insightful, educational, bold, tongue-in-cheek and above all very funny, the teams do battle over four rounds - it's history with a touch of colour.

programme.title: Shop on TV
programme.desc: Teleshopping.

programme.title: Nobody's Fool
programme.desc: Emily Atack and Danny Dyer host a strategic reality quiz packed full of drama and deception. With fewer players left and the finale looming, alliances tighten and betrayals feel inevitable. Harry reveals himself to be great at maths and this has not gone unnoticed. The game has now turned - whispered conversations, overheard plots and shifting loyalties dominate the house as players begin thinking not about survival, but about who they want to face in the final. A maths/shooting-led challenge rewards bold, decisive play from Billy and delivers a powerful advantage - but are Harry's days numbered? With trust diminishing by the hour, does Kamaal succumb to group pressure or does he turn on one of the co-conspirators - and also his friend - Ella? Regardless, playing nicely is no longer an option.

programme.title: Long Lost Family
programme.desc: Both stories in this episode celebrate the unique bond between brothers - in our first case, Lee Sharp's adoptive parents had told him that he was a foundling, but the Long Lost Family team discovers that this simply isn't true as the true story leads Lee to a sibling that he never knew he had and with whom he shares so much. In our second case, Peter MacDonald's father snatched him from his mother's arms as a baby as a train carrying her and his older brother Trevor pulled out of Preston station - it was the last time Peter ever saw them, and he longs to see Trevor again after 58 years of missing his big brother.

programme.title: Unwind with ITV

programme.title: James Martin's American Adventure
programme.desc: James's American adventure continues with a cruise along California's Pacific Coast as he rides his motorcycle through the coastal city of Santa Cruz and takes in the fertile nature of the local farmland along the way - he then shops at a local farmers' market before cooking his own recipes on a family-run artichoke farm. James can't leave Santa Cruz before trying his hand at surfing - only to be upstaged by a dog when he does - and uses the area's rich farming heritage as inspiration to cook California-style food back at home in the UK.

programme.title: Nobody's Fool
programme.desc: Emily Atack and Danny Dyer host a strategic reality quiz packed full of drama and deception. With fewer players left and the finale looming, alliances tighten and betrayals feel inevitable. Harry reveals himself to be great at maths and this has not gone unnoticed. The game has now turned - whispered conversations, overheard plots and shifting loyalties dominate the house as players begin thinking not about survival, but about who they want to face in the final. A maths/shooting-led challenge rewards bold, decisive play from Billy and delivers a powerful advantage - but are Harry's days numbered? With trust diminishing by the hour, does Kamaal succumb to group pressure or does he turn on one of the co-conspirators - and also his friend - Ella? Regardless, playing nicely is no longer an option.

programme.title: Long Lost Family
programme.desc: Both stories in this episode celebrate the unique bond between brothers - in our first case, Lee Sharp's adoptive parents had told him that he was a foundling, but the Long Lost Family team discovers that this simply isn't true as the true story leads Lee to a sibling that he never knew he had and with whom he shares so much. In our second case, Peter MacDonald's father snatched him from his mother's arms as a baby as a train carrying her and his older brother Trevor pulled out of Preston station - it was the last time Peter ever saw them, and he longs to see Trevor again after 58 years of missing his big brother.

programme.title: James Martin's American Adventure
programme.desc: James's American adventure continues with a cruise along California's Pacific Coast as he rides his motorcycle through the coastal city of Santa Cruz and takes in the fertile nature of the local farmland along the way - he then shops at a local farmers' market before cooking his own recipes on a family-run artichoke farm. programme.title: Prue Leith's Cotswold Kitchen
programme.desc: This series takes us into the home of Prue Leith and her husband John as she, friends and her husband cook mouth-watering dishes and explore the joys of their Cotswold home and local area. In this episode, Prue cooks a range of recipes perfect for entertaining guests before welcoming Alison Hammond into her kitchen as the pair make something sweet together - in a bid to prove the ingredient's versatility, Prue then cooks two recipes using watermelon in unusual ways. Prue also utilises a pre-made shop-bought ingredient for quick and delicious party food both sweet and savoury, her husband John visits a farm to see how local sheepdogs are trained, and we hear from a group of friends on how they produce smoked salmon using age-old techniques.

programme.title: Nanny Mcphee
programme.desc: Fantasy family comedy. Recently-widowed Cedric Brown struggles to control his brood of seven children, who have managed to drive away 17 different nannies with their bad behaviour - when Cedric arranges for the mysterious Nanny McPhee to come and look after the children, led by the precocious Simon, the children attempt to scare her in the same way as they have the others, but it soon becomes clear that their bad behaviour brings about supernatural and eerie reprisals... Meanwhile, Cedric's uptight Aunt Adelaide has insisted that unless he finds a new wife within a month, she will take one of the children into custody. With their father's utter hopelessness at courtship common knowledge and facing a future in the workhouse - or worse, in the care of relatives, the children turn to their new nanny to save the day.

programme.title: The Staircase
programme.desc: December 2001. When businesswoman and beloved mother Kathleen Peterson is found dead after reportedly falling down a flight of stairs, the unusually bloody scene leads police to focus their attention on her husband, author and aspiring local politician Michael Peterson. But while the Peterson's blended family rallies around their patriarch, the investigation quickly zeroes in on Michael's secret life, calling the couple's seemingly picture-perfect marriage into question.

programme.title: The Staircase
programme.desc: December 2001. When businesswoman and beloved mother Kathleen Peterson is found dead after reportedly falling down a flight of stairs, the unusually bloody scene leads police to focus their attention on her husband, author and aspiring local politician Michael Peterson. programme.title: The Staircase
programme.desc: After posting bail, Michael and his high-powered attorney David Rudolf piece together their defence, while considering an offer from Jean-Xavier de Lestrade, a French documentarian eager to profile the case. As teams of forensic experts on both sides recreate the night of Kathleen's death, Michael's children grapple with shocking new information about their father - and his stepdaughter Caitlin wrestles with her own doubts.

programme.title: Sorry, I Didn't Know
programme.desc: Jimmy Akingbola hosts the classic panel show with a twist - this time Charlene White, Shazia Mirza, Jessica Fostekew and Stephen K Amos join team leaders Chizzy Akudolu and Eddie Kadi to take viewers on a tour of Black British history. Insightful, educational, bold, tongue-in-cheek and above all very funny, the teams do battle over four rounds - it's history with a touch of colour.

programme.title: Nanny Mcphee
programme.desc: Fantasy family comedy. Recently-widowed Cedric Brown struggles to control his brood of seven children, who have managed to drive away 17 different nannies with their bad behaviour - when Cedric arranges for the mysterious Nanny McPhee to come and look after the children, led by the precocious Simon, the children attempt to scare her in the same way as they have the others, but it soon becomes clear that their bad behaviour brings about supernatural and eerie reprisals... Meanwhile, Cedric's uptight Aunt Adelaide has insisted that unless he finds a new wife within a month, she will take one of the children into custody. With their father's utter hopelessness at courtship common knowledge and facing a future in the workhouse - or worse, in the care of relatives, the children turn to their new nanny to save the day.

But while the Peterson's blended family rallies around their patriarch, the investigation quickly zeroes in on Michael's secret life, calling the couple's seemingly picture-perfect marriage into question.

programme.title: The Staircase
programme.desc: After posting bail, Michael and his high-powered attorney David Rudolf piece together their defence, while considering an offer from Jean-Xavier de Lestrade, a French documentarian eager to profile the case. As teams of forensic experts on both sides recreate the night of Kathleen's death, Michael's children grapple with shocking new information about their father - and his stepdaughter Caitlin wrestles with her own doubts.

programme.title: Sorry, I Didn't Know

programme.title: Prue Leith's Cotswold Kitchen
programme.desc: This series takes us into the home of Prue Leith and her husband John as she, friends and her husband cook mouth-watering dishes and explore the joys of their Cotswold home and local area. In this episode, Prue cooks a range of recipes perfect for entertaining guests before welcoming Alison Hammond into her kitchen as the pair make something sweet together - in a bid to prove the ingredient's versatility, Prue then cooks two recipes using watermelon in unusual ways. Prue also utilises a pre-made shop-bought ingredient for quick and delicious party food both sweet and savoury, her husband John visits a farm to see how local sheepdogs are trained, and we hear from a group of friends on how they produce smoked salmon using age-old techniques.

programme.title: Nanny Mcphee
programme.desc: Fantasy family comedy. Recently-widowed Cedric Brown struggles to control his brood of seven children, who have managed to drive away 17 different nannies with their bad behaviour - when Cedric arranges for the mysterious Nanny McPhee to come and look after the children, led by the precocious Simon, the children attempt to scare her in the same way as they have the others, but it soon becomes clear that their bad behaviour brings about supernatural and eerie reprisals... Meanwhile, Cedric's uptight Aunt Adelaide has insisted that unless he finds a new wife within a month, she will take one of the children into custody. With their father's utter hopelessness at courtship common knowledge and facing a future in the workhouse - or worse, in the care of relatives, the children turn to their new nanny to save the day.

programme.title: The Staircase
programme.desc: December 2001. When businesswoman and beloved mother Kathleen Peterson is found dead after reportedly falling down a flight of stairs, the unusually bloody scene leads police to focus their attention on her husband, author and aspiring local politician Michael Peterson. But while the Peterson's blended family rallies around their patriarch, the investigation quickly zeroes in on Michael's secret life, calling the couple's seemingly picture-perfect marriage into question.

programme.title: The Staircase
programme.desc: After posting bail, Michael and his high-powered attorney David Rudolf piece together their defence, while considering an offer from Jean-Xavier de Lestrade, a French documentarian eager to profile the case. As teams of forensic experts on both sides recreate the night of Kathleen's death, Michael's children grapple with shocking new information about their father - and his stepdaughter Caitlin wrestles with her own doubts.

programme.title: Sorry, I Didn't Know
programme.desc: Jimmy Akingbola hosts the classic panel show with a twist - this time Charlene White, Shazia Mirza, Jessica Fostekew and Stephen K Amos join team leaders Chizzy Akudolu and Eddie Kadi to take viewers on a tour of Black British history. Insightful, educational, bold, tongue-in-cheek and above all very funny, the teams do battle over four rounds - it's history with a touch of colour.

programme.title: Nobody's Fool
programme.desc: Emily Atack and Danny Dyer host a strategic reality quiz packed full of drama and deception. With fewer players left and the finale looming, alliances tighten and betrayals feel inevitable. Harry reveals himself to be great at maths and this has not gone unnoticed. The game has now turned - whispered conversations, overheard plots and shifting loyalties dominate the house as players begin thinking not about survival, but about who they want to face in the final. A maths/shooting-led challenge rewards bold, decisive play from Billy and delivers a powerful advantage - but are Harry's days numbered? With trust diminishing by the hour, does Kamaal succumb to group pressure or does he turn on one of the co-conspirators - and also his friend - Ella? Regardless, playing nicely is no longer an option.

programme.title: Killer Fish

programme.title: What's On TPTV With Noel
programme.desc: Founder of Talking Pictures TV and one half of the Footage Detectives, Noel Cronin, shares shows and films not to be missed throughout the end of July and beginning of August. [S]

programme.title: Turn of Fate
programme.desc: Silhouette Of A Killer. 1957. Stars Robert Ryan, Beverly Garland & Irving Bacon. A lone woman hears reports of a killer on the loose, then a man who cannot remember his name bursts into her house.

programme.title: The Vise
programme.desc: The Very Silent Traveller. 1954. Stars Ron Randell, Ronan O'Casey & Sam Kydd. Recently released convict Dickie Miller murders Arnold Brockley in an act of revenge. [S]

programme.title: The Rogues
programme.desc: Wherefore Art Thou, Harold? 1965. Gig Young, David Niven and Charles Boyer are The Rogues, members of two related families of international forgers and conmen. [S]

programme.title: Phantom Ship
programme.desc: 1935. Mystery. Directed by Denison Clift. Stars Bela Lugosi, Shirley Grey & Arthur Margetson. During a terrible storm, the crew of a ship realise a murderer is among them, killing them one by one. [S]

programme.title: A-Bob-In-The-Pound with Tommy...
programme.desc: ... Handley - Glimpses. 1943. The well-known British comedian, Tommy Handley, gets us to sing along to start saving for the war effort and brighter days to come.

programme.title: Runaround
programme.desc: 1980. Presented by Mike Reid. Prizes include a slimline hairdryer and a woodworking set. This episode features a 1912 Bugatti racing car and The Distractions singing 'Something for the weekend'

programme.title: Legend of the Hidden City
programme.desc: 1997. Stars Brendan Pollecutt, Fezile Mpela & Robert Finlayson. Dean and Nina face killer bees as they journey to the swamplands to free Princess Kama.

programme.title: William Tell
programme.desc: The Gauntlet of St Gerhardt. 1958. Stars Conrad Phillips, Willoughby Goddard & Jennifer Jayne. A religious relic, the Gauntlet of St Gerhardt, appears to inspire the Swiss to feats of valour. [S]

programme.title: ABC Minors Song
programme.desc: We come Along, On Saturday Mornings! Join us as we sing The ABC minors song and get ready for this Saturdays show! [S]

programme.title: Batman
programme.desc: Nora Clavicle and the Ladies Crime Club. 1968. Stars Adam West, Burt Ward & Yvonne Craig. A women's rights activist uses her influence to have the whole police force fired and replaced with women. [S]

programme.title: Hawkeye & the Last of the Mohicans
programme.desc: False Witness. 1957. Directed by Sam Newfield. Stars John Hart, Lon Chaney Jr & Rodney Bunker. Army payroll messengers are found dead, murdered by a gang of bandits. [S]

programme.title: Captain Scarlet and the Mysterons
programme.desc: Flight 104. 1968. Stars Francis Matthews & David Healy. The Mysterons threaten to sabotage a conference in Switzerland, Scarlet and Blue are assigned to escort the world's leading astrophysicist. [S]

programme.title: Supercar
programme.desc: False Alarm. 1961. Stars David Graham, George Murcell & Graydon Gould. The Supercar team receives a distress call instigated by Masterspy to rescue two geologists trapped in the mountains. [S]

programme.title: The Buccaneers
programme.desc: Indian Fighters. 1957. Stars Robert Shaw, Ronan O'Casey & Jane Griffiths. Tempest returns a famous Indian fighter to his hometown. Instead of a hero's welcome, the fighter is charged with treason. [S]

programme.title: The Adventures of Robin Hood
programme.desc: Hubert. 1956. Stars Richard Greene, Alexander Gauge & Dorothy Bromiley. Sir Hubert seeks Robin Hood's help to reunite him with his true love before she is married off to another man. [S]

programme.title: The Brain from Planet Arous
programme.desc: 1957. Sci-fi. Directed by Nathan Juran. Stars John Agar, Joyce Meadows & Robert Fuller. A brain shaped alien possesses a young scientist and attempts to take over the world. Can anyone stop it? [S]

programme.title: Went The Day Well?
programme.desc: 1942. War. Director: Cavalcanti. Stars: Leslie Banks, Mervyn Johns & Basil Sydney. English villagers stage a fight back when visited by a platoon of German troops. [S]

programme.title: Whiplash
programme.desc: Dilemma in Wool. 1961. Stars Peter Graves, Anthony Wickert & Janette Craig. Cobb picks up a woman along with her 'husband' and 'baby'. Cobb soon fears that he is involved in a kidnapping scheme. [S]

programme.title: The Thirty Nine Steps (1978)
programme.desc: 1978. Crime. Director: Don Sharp. Stars Robert Powell, Karen Dotrice, David Warner & John Mills. An engineer attempts to prevent Prussian agents from executing a political assassination. [S]

programme.title: A Day Begins in Manchester (1960s)
programme.desc: Warming Glimpses of Manchester 'waking up'. From the streets to the factories and the docks and everything in between.

programme.title: Dick Turpin
programme.desc: The Upright Man. 1979. Stars Richard O'Sullivan, Michael Deeks & Ray McAnally. Suspecting betrayal, Dick decides to visit the Brotherhood's leader known as the Upright Man. [S]

programme.title: Maigret
programme.desc: The Old Lady. 1960. Stars Rupert Davies, Ewen Solon & Marie Ney. Conflicting reports of a maid's death takes Maigret to Normandy to investigate the charming Madame Beeson and her children. [S]

programme.title: The Duchess of Duke Street
programme.desc: Winter Lament. 1977. Stars Gemma Jones, Christopher Cazenove & Joanna David. Louisa visits Lord and Lady Haslemere in Yorkshire and finds a bleak and desperately unhappy household. [S]

programme.title: Night of the Eagle
programme.desc: 1962. Horror. Director: Sidney Hayers. Stars Peter Wyngarde, Janet Blair & Margaret Johnston. A woman, who may be a witch, defends her husband from forces attempting to harm him. [S]

programme.title: EuroTrash
programme.desc: 1996. Tonight, meet a female contortionist and Eurotrash profiles 3 Italian female erotic cartoonists who are challenging a traditionally male industry and sexual stereotypes.

programme.title: Fortean TV
programme.desc: 1997. Hosted by Reverend Lionel Fanthorpe. Tonight, buy a ticket to Mexico to see the miracle known as the Virgin of the Subway, wander the Gobi Desert in search for the Mongolian death worm.

programme.title: One Step Beyond
programme.desc: The Aerialist. 1959. Starring: John Newland, Mike Connors & Yvette Vickers. An argument between trapeze artists results in an accident in which one is paralysed, and the other is torn by guilt. [S]

programme.title: Night of the Demon
programme.desc: (AKA Curse of the Demon) 1957. Horror. Director: Jacques Tourneur. Stars Dana Andrews, Peggy Cummins & Niall MacGinnis. A professor arrives in London and investigates a devil worshipper. [S]

programme.title: Nobody's Fool
programme.desc: Emily Atack and Danny Dyer host a strategic reality quiz packed full of drama and deception. With fewer players left and the finale looming, alliances tighten and betrayals feel inevitable. Harry reveals himself to be great at maths and this has not gone unnoticed. The game has now turned - whispered conversations, overheard plots and shifting loyalties dominate the house as players begin thinking not about survival, but about who they want to face in the final. A maths/shooting-led challenge rewards bold, decisive play from Billy and delivers a powerful advantage - but are Harry's days numbered? With trust diminishing by the hour, does Kamaal succumb to group pressure or does he turn on one of the co-conspirators - and also his friend - Ella? Regardless, playing nicely is no longer an option.

programme.title: Long Lost Family

In our second case, Peter MacDonald's father snatched him from his mother's arms as a baby as a train carrying her and his older brother Trevor pulled out of Preston station - it was the last time Peter ever saw them, and he longs to see Trevor again after 58 years of missing his big brother.
